retrievalProfile.description: A framed portrait layout featuring a central subject against a warm gradient background with delicate script typography in the upper corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a man in a patterned suit, set against a soft brown-to-pink gradient background, all contained within a thin black frame and a wide light-blue outer border. Elegant, thin script text is positioned in the top left and right corners of the inner frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a nested frame structure
Warm interior tones contrasting with a cool-toned outer border
Delicate typography balanced in the upper corners
Soft studio lighting creating a gentle vignette effect
coreInvariants: Thin black inner border separating the image from the outer frame
Symmetrical placement of text in the top corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, emphasized by the surrounding dark hair and patterned suit.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves outward to the corner typography, then follows the border around the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant soft-focus background space around the head and shoulders to allow the subject to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light blue-grey for the outer border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark brown/black of the suit and hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, nostalgic value range; the border provides a cool, flat counterpoint.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant, slanted script with high-contrast strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters are tightly spaced and rhythmic
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script face used for both artist and title to maintain formal elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast 70s script style.
Provides the necessary formal flourishes and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a 70s patterned suit against a warm brown gradient, framed by a thin black line and a wide light-blue border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, elegant script text in the top-left and top-right corners using a dark brown color.

verificationChecks: Is the text placed in the extreme top corners?
Is there a clear distinction between the inner image and the outer blue border?
Is the lighting soft and warm?

postGenerationChecks: Check for thin black keyline between image and border
Verify script font is light and elegant
Confirm color palette is muted and warm
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Warm Gradient + Thin Keyline + Wide Border + Corner Script = 70s Soul Aesthetic
